steps.title: Define App Specifications and Package Name
steps.description: Configure the app metadata details with package name 'com.moderncalculator.app' and name 'Modern Calculator'.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct compileSdk, minSdk, and targetSdk versions under Java 8 compliance.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Define standard Android Manifest with launcher activity, landscape/portrait optimizations, and dark material theme.

steps.title: Configure Color Resources
steps.description: Specify beautiful theme colors in colors.xml for buttons (numeric, operator, special) and dark background.

steps.title: Configure String Resources
steps.description: Define the localization strings file containing the application name and key UI labels.

steps.title: Create Numeric Button Background
steps.description: Create custom selector XML with modern rounded corners and highlight colors for pressing numeric buttons.

steps.title: Create Operator Button Background
steps.description: Create custom selector XML with standard warm accent colors for operators.

steps.title: Create Special Button Background
steps.description: Create custom selector XML with light gray style for utility keys (Clear, Backspace, % etc.).

steps.title: Create Equal Button Background
steps.description: Create custom selector XML for the main action equals key styled in beautiful green.

steps.title: Design Modern User Interface Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout styling display text boxes with horizontal scrolling and dynamic uniform grid keys.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Core Engine and Handlers
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java logic with event bindings, sign toggles, percent operations, and smart recursive descent parser.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the code with Gradle assembleDebug step to produce output artifact.
